_comment: Synthesis for the closing slide: a strong association, chance ruled out, design still open. Sets up L04 without teaching its mechanisms.

stem.en: The live case (illustrative) gives an odds ratio of 13.2 with P < 0.001. Which statement is the fairest reading of that result?

text.en: Tank cleaners had 13.2 times the risk of the tumour, compared with the other men at the plant
A P value below 0.001 proves that tank cleaning caused the tumour in these men
The association is strong and unlikely to be chance, but the way the study was run could still have built part of it
A case-control study produces no usable number, so the odds ratio should be ignored

explanation.en: 13.2 is an odds ratio, not a risk, so it does not say that a tank cleaner's risk was 13.2 times anyone else's. The P value rules out chance as an explanation for a gap this large. What it cannot rule out is a gap produced by the way the cases and controls were selected, interviewed or matched, so the design still has to be checked.

hints.en: Separate the two questions the file has asked: could chance explain the gap, and could the way the study was run explain it?
